integrity: Exact series and raising integral are cited from the original sources; no independent external audit or global originality certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Strict real-argument all-angle positivity for p=1 and real orders at least four; necessity is established only for nonnegative integer orders. The complete range of noninteger orders below four and other p are not classified. Earlier restricted p-radial literature may contain implicit overlap.
title: Fourth-order universal positivity for diamond \(p\)-Bessel kernels
